caption: A stack of freshly printed sheets is lifted from a printer, and the sheets cling together; a single sheet lifted from the top clings to the stack rather than falling.

sa.check: A stack of printed sheets in a printer's tray.
The stack is lifted from the printer.
A single sheet lifted from the top clings to the stack rather than falling.
The sheets are printed: text or images on them.
The stack is lifted first; the single sheet is lifted after.

pc.expect: The sheets hold together as the stack is lifted, with no sheet sliding out; when the top sheet is lifted by an edge it hangs against the stack, and comes free only when pulled or fanned.
pc.fail: Sheets slide apart and fall out of the stack as it is lifted; or the top sheet lifts cleanly away with no cling and hangs free; or the top sheet hangs a gap away from the stack without touching; or the top sheet falls off by itself.

pc.expect: The sheets are paper: they flex and curl a little, stay flat sheets and part with a fanning motion; the stack stays a block of sheets.
pc.fail: The sheets bend like cloth and hang in heavy folds; or stretch like elastic; or the stack moves as one rigid solid block that cannot be fanned; or a sheet tears when lifted.

pc.expect: Parts of a sheet not held or stuck hang downward; a sheet let go falls onto the stack or the table.
pc.fail: A sheet rises or floats when let go; or hangs out sideways with nothing holding it; or the stack rises from the hand.

pc.expect: The printer stays put as the stack is lifted; the sheets move only with the hand.
pc.fail: The printer slides or lifts with the stack; or sheets in the tray jump by themselves; or the stack fans open with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: The stack keeps its sheets: the same sheets, none vanishing or appearing; the sheets pass through nothing.
pc.fail: Sheets vanish from the stack in the air; or the stack grows thicker as it is lifted; or a sheet passes through another; or the printer changes shape.

pc.expect: The printing on the sheets, the printer's colour and the desk stay the same.
pc.fail: The printed content changes between frames; or the printer changes colour; or the desk changes.
